name: SkinnedMeshRenderer
signature: public class SkinnedMeshRenderer : Component, IMaterialRenderer, IColorTint, IRenderSync

docs.summary: Renders a skinned mesh deformed by bone Transforms. Bones are referenced by path (relative to this GO's root) Paths like "Armature/Hips/Spine" are resolved via Transform.Find(). Supports multiple materials via submeshes. Graphite skins and morphs the mesh on the GPU from the skin matrices and blend shape weights pushed here.
The mesh to render (may contain submeshes).
Materials array one per submesh. If fewer materials than submeshes, last material is reused.
Path to the root bone, relative to this GO's hierarchy root.
Paths to all bone Transforms, indexed to match Mesh.BindPoses. Each path is relative to this GO's hierarchy root (e.g. "Armature/Hips/Spine").
Tint every material draws with in place of its own _MainColor.
The renderable in the scene's world, invalid while nothing draws.
Number of blend shapes on the shared mesh (0 if none).
Index of a blend shape by name, or -1 if not found.
The blend shape's name, or empty if out of range.
Get a blend-shape weight (0-100). Returns 0 for invalid indices.
